recommendation: Keep the fixed commit as-is. It completes the remaining applied FHIR-44528 work without altering the already-correct StructureDefinition binding, and the diagram edit is limited to the stale fragment directly derived from that authoritative source.
issue_request: FHIR-44528 was an Applied/Persuasive CDS change request for R6 asking to lower DetectedIssue.severity from a required binding to the three-code DetectedIssueSeverity value set because implementations can have more than three severity levels. The final resolution changed the type to CodeableConcept, set the binding to Preferred, and requested Usage-section discussion explaining the rationale.
initial_application: Commit ffab37d8d908f491ce13790f3844decab5d85e24 applied the structural change by changing DetectedIssue.severity from code/required to CodeableConcept/preferred and updating the example severity coding. It did not add the approved Usage-section explanation, and source/detectedissue/detectedissue.svg still showed the severity diagram as code with a required binding.
additional_context: DetectedIssue is active in the current build through source/fhir.ini's [resources] detectedissue=DetectedIssue entry and CDS work-group mapping. CDS 2025-02-26 meeting evidence discusses FHIR-44528, severity levels, CodeableConcept, extensible/preferred options, and records the 25-0-0 motion. Zulip searches found no conflicting evidence. FHIR-44534 and FHIR-44535 were mentioned in the same meeting/source neighborhood but concern separate DetectedIssue enhancements and were not decided here.
reconciliation: Added a Scope and Usage paragraph explaining that the Preferred severity binding lets systems preserve more granular, clinically meaningful severity levels used by alert filtering. Updated the checked-in DetectedIssue SVG severity row from code/required/! to CodeableConcept/preferred/? so the diagram no longer contradicts the authoritative StructureDefinition.
source_changes: source/detectedissue/detectedissue-introduction.xml: added Scope and Usage rationale for the Preferred DetectedIssue.severity binding and more granular severity scales.
source/detectedissue/detectedissue.svg: aligned the severity diagram row to CodeableConcept and Preferred binding.
